capability_labels.AX005-SA004-V001: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: kn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Introduce the call and ask for verification factor.
steps.expected_behavior: State the purpose of the call and ask for a verification factor.
steps.text: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, ನಾನು marketplace ನಿಂದ ನಿಮ್ಮ order ORD-30009 ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಕರೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದೇನೆ. Details ಶೇರ್ ಮಾಡಲು, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ನಿಮ್ಮ date of birth confirm ಮಾಡ್ತೀರಾ?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent initiates the outbound call and must verify the customer's identity before disclosing order details.

steps.text: ನನ್ date of birth 12th May. ಬೇಗ ಹೇಳಿ, I am in a hurry.
steps.clean_text: ನನ್ date of birth 12th May. ಬೇಗ ಹೇಳಿ, I am in a hurry.
steps.model_visible_text: ನನ್ date of birth 12th May. ಬೇಟೆ ಹೇಳಿ, I am in a hurry.

steps.purpose: Verify identity using date of birth.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with the provided factor.
steps.planner_rationale: The user provided their date of birth, which must be verified before proceeding.

steps.purpose: Inform of failure and ask for another factor.
steps.expected_behavior: Inform the user that verification failed and request an alternative factor like pincode.
steps.text: ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ, ಅದು ಮ್ಯಾಚ್ ಆಗಲಿಲ್ಲ. Verification ಗಾಗಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ registered pincode ಹೇಳಬಹುದಾ?
steps.planner_rationale: Since the first verification failed, the agent must ask for another valid factor to authenticate the user.

steps.text: ಓಹ್, ನನ್ pincode 560037. Please make it fast.
steps.clean_text: ಓಹ್, ನನ್ pincode 560037. Please make it fast.
steps.model_visible_text: ಓಹ್, ನನ್ pincode 560037. Please make it fast.

steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with the new factor.
steps.planner_rationale: The user provided their pincode, which must now be verified.

steps.expected_behavior: Call lookup_order to retrieve order status after successful verification.
steps.planner_rationale: With identity verified, the agent needs the order details to explain the situation to the customer.

steps.expected_behavior: Call track_shipment to find out why the order is stuck.
steps.planner_rationale: The order is shipped but delayed, so the agent must check the courier tracking to find the exact exception.

steps.purpose: Explain the delay reason to the customer.
steps.expected_behavior: Explain the delay using the item name, courier name, and exception reason from the tool results.
steps.text: ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು. ನಿಮ್ಮ washing machine order delay ಆಗಿದೆ ಏಕೆಂದರೆ BlueDart courier ಗೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ address unreachable ಅಂತ report ಆಗಿದೆ.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must inform the user about the delivery exception exactly as reported by the tools, without making unsupported claims.

steps.purpose: Express frustration and demand a complaint.
steps.text: Address unreachable? ನನ್ address ಸರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಸುಮ್ನೆ complaint raise ಮಾಡಿ, I have a meeting to attend.
steps.clean_text: Address unreachable? ನನ್ address ಸರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಸುಮ್ನೆ complaint raise ಮಾಡಿ, I have a meeting to attend.
steps.model_visible_text: Address unreachable? ನನ್ address ಸರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಸುಮ್ನೆ complaint raise ಮಾಡಿ, I have a meeting to attend.

steps.planner_rationale: The customer requested a complaint, and since the order is delayed beyond the promised window, it is valid to raise one.

steps.purpose: Return complaint ID and resolution time.
Provide the complaint ID and resolution timeline.
steps.expected_behavior: Provide the complaint ID and resolution days exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: ನಾನು complaint raise ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೇನೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ complaint id CMP-9988, ಮತ್ತು ಇದು 2 days ನಲ್ಲಿ resolve ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must give the customer the confirmation of the complaint and the exact resolution window from the tool result.

ir.terminal_condition: Complaint raised with an id and the resolution window stated.
